image:image.image:caption: Upgrade your precision inspection tools with high-quality Thread Plug Gauges from SV Nanometrology Pvt Ltd, a trusted manufacturer and supplier of industrial gauges since 2005 in India. Our Thread Plug Gauges are engineered for accuracy and durability, ideal for checking internal threads in mechanical components across industries like automotive, aerospace, manufacturing, and defence. Made from imported OHNS material (Hardness: 58-62 HRC) and calibrated to ISO, IS, DIN, ANSI, and BS standards, our GO / NO-GO thread plug gauges ensure fast and reliable thread inspection. We offer a wide range of thread forms including Metric, UNF, UNC, BSP, NPT, and customised options based on your specifications.

image:image.image:caption: Ensure the accuracy and reliability of your dimensional measurements with professional CMM Calibration Services from SV Nanometrology Pvt Ltd, a leading provider of precision metrology and calibration solutions in India since 2000.
